competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, apply only to a subset of items, or be superseded by a newer policy with a different timeframe.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current policy for standard items provides a full-refund return window of 30 days from delivery.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows the full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days from delivery, or standard items are excluded from full refunds.
